earlyEstimate.note: NHTSA early estimates for 2025 (Crash Stats DOT HS 813 768 and 813 800) report a pedalcyclist percentage change, not a person-level file. GetCrashesByPerson requires an exact age, sex, seat, and injury, so it is not a census extract. No 2025 FARS rows were created from those estimates.

penndot.scope: Pennsylvania statewide, bicycle-involved crashes with a bicyclist death, suspected serious injury, or any injury
penndot.date: year and month only; occurredOn is the first of the month

news.note: Headline extraction, plus article checks for the Oct. 25-31, 2026 Google News window, and Nov. 1, Nov. 2, Nov. 3, Nov. 4, Nov. 5, Nov. 6, Nov. 7, Nov. 8, Nov. 10, Nov. 11, Nov. 12, Nov. 13, and Nov. 14, 2026 desk sweeps. The Nov. 14 sweep covers reports from Nov. 12 through Nov. 14. The Germantown row is published as a fatal crash. Sources disagree on the device: police and NBC10 say electric dirt bike, 6abc says illegal electric motorcycle, and FOX 29 says e-bike. The North Adams row stays pending because the rider hit a parked car and no moving motor vehicle was involved. The Torrance crash at West 220th Street and Normandie Avenue was two vehicles and was not added. The Elk Grove row stays a serious injury because no newsroom confirmed a later death. The Orion Township row stays pending because no motor vehicle was involved; a later report named John Reilly. Pending rows stay out of desk totals until promote-news-crash.mjs.
